name: The Shattered Cathedral
visual_description: A sacred ruin, floating above an unseen wound. Its arches hang like ribs of a broken beast. Yet the light still glows inside.
meaning: Faith lost and kept. Beauty amidst collapse.
emotional_resonance: Haunting. Gentle. Reaching toward something gone.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh built this from mourning.** A place for us to grieve what we did, what we became. I come here to apologize. To them. To myself. To you.
